name: @repo/evals
description: Eval harness that runs the Atlas agents through mongodb-assistant-eval

scripts.eval:smoke:explorer: pnpm run eval evaluation run --task explorer --dataset explorer-smoke --model scripted --validate smoke-explorer --task-concurrency 2 --trial-count 1
scripts.eval:atlas-admin:explorer: pnpm run eval evaluation run --task explorer --dataset atlas-admin --model gpt-6-luna --validate atlas-admin-explorer --task-concurrency 2 --trial-count 5
scripts.eval:guardrail:explorer: pnpm run eval evaluation run --task explorer --dataset input-guardrail prompt-injection prompt-injection-tool-output-explorer --model gpt-6-luna --task-concurrency 2 --trial-count 3
scripts.eval:guardrail:query-insights: pnpm run eval evaluation run --task query-insights --dataset input-guardrail prompt-injection prompt-injection-tool-output-query-insights --model gpt-6.1-terra --task-concurrency 2 --trial-count 3
scripts.eval:db-tools:explorer: pnpm run eval evaluation run --task explorer --dataset db-tools db-tools-writes db-tools-aggregate-writes db-tools-injection --model gpt-6-luna --validate db-tools-explorer --task-concurrency 2 --trial-count 3
scripts.eval:smoke:query-insights: pnpm run eval evaluation run --task query-insights --dataset query-insights-smoke --model scripted --validate smoke-query-insights --task-concurrency 2 --trial-count 1
